qualification.reason: Final candidate source must be committed and pass the exact-source maintained CI gates.

live_providers.reason: No final-candidate paid-provider report is recorded. A provider report or a named, expiring risk disposition is required.

terminal_manual.reason: Named graphical terminals need actual manual evidence or a scoped, owned, expiring risk disposition; synthetic PTYs are not manual passes.

long_soak.reason: Record final-candidate long-soak evidence or an owned, expiring disposition separately from bounded deterministic runtime CI.

release_holds: Final exact-source maintained CI must pass, including original 100-command/10-warmup Linux/macOS startup SLO.
Unrun external qualification groups need truthful dispositions before publication.

baseline_only.note: Prior main review is historical evidence, not qualification of the 1.1.0 candidate.
